modelingNotes: Exact Murrelektronik article85040; historic source manufacturer Murr is preserved. Manufacturer exact-product diagram establishes 1=PE,2=N,3=L,4=DC− and5=DC+. Diagram numbers are retained rather than connector-local table indices.

Adjustable output and universal/variable input are capability ranges. No input/output nominal_voltage or conditional current scalar is assigned. Output ratings are total supply capability, not independent allowances on duplicate clamps. Project intent must specify the chosen supply voltage.

Input pins1/2/3 are required for the powered abstraction. Output connections are application-dependent. No field bond to DC return is invented. The device outline is not a wire; function membership never creates net continuity.

Five field terminals, no duplicate output clamps. Exact diagram and inventory show no additional signal/communication/PE interface; output indication and adjuster are not signal terminals. No permanent terminal-to-terminal links are asserted.

Input90–265 VAC /110–300 VDC. Output12 VDC nominal,5 A,60 W total; exact current sheet disagrees internally on adjustment lower bound10 V versus12 V. Upper bound15 V. Preserve that discrepancy and avoid a fixed12 V compiler constraint.

Clamp technology and installed manufacturing revision must be checked against the physical device; exact current diagrams do not prove every historical unit revision. No housing/mounting bond path is inferred from metalwork.

connectionCoverage.notes: All five documented terminals inventoried from the manufacturer connection diagram: 3-pole input (L, N, PE) and 2-pole output (DC+, DC-). No signal, communication, remote-sense or DC-OK terminals exist on this model. Output is SELV-isolated from input.

1.description: Input terminal 1 = PE (protective earth); 3-pole input spring-clamp FK block

2.description: Input terminal 2 = N (neutral); 3-pole input spring-clamp FK block

3.description: Input terminal 3 = L (line); 3-pole input spring-clamp FK block. Universal input 90-265 V AC / 110-300 V DC, 50-60 Hz (range in notes; no single nominal assigned)

4.description: Output terminal 4 = DC- (negative); 2-pole output spring-clamp FK block

5.description: Output terminal 5 = DC+ (positive); 2-pole output spring-clamp FK block. 12 V DC nominal, adjustable to 15 V; 5 A (6 A UL/45 C)
